description: Masterplan Fietspaden (fietspaden) (historie) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Classificatie van de kwaliteit van de fietspaden in alle Drentse gemeenten en de gemeente Ooststellingwerf. Coverage: all Drenthe municipalities and the municipality of Ooststellingwerf. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are fietsen, recreatie, recreatieschap, verkeer. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
